description: Complete American Sign Language alphabet and numbers for left hand

A.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 70 L120 70 M80 90 L120 90 M80 110 L120 110 M80 130 L120 130" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
A.description: ASL letter A - Fist with thumb on the side
A.instructions: Make a fist with your left hand, keeping your thumb to the side of your fingers

B.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M50 50 L50 150 M50 50 L150 50 L150 100 L50 100 L50 150 L150 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
B.description: ASL letter B - Flat hand with fingers together
B.instructions: Hold your left hand flat with all fingers together and extended

C.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M50 50 Q100 50 150 100 Q100 150 50 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
C.instructions: Curve your left hand fingers and thumb to form a C shape

D.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50 M80 70 L120 70 M80 90 L120 90 M80 110 L120 110 M80 130 L120 130" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
D.description: ASL letter D - Index finger pointing up with other fingers closed
D.instructions: Point your index finger up with your left hand, keeping other fingers closed

E.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L120 50 L120 150 L80 150 Z" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
E.description: ASL letter E - Fingers curled down
E.instructions: Curl all fingers of your left hand down toward your palm

F.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50 M80 70 L120 70" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
F.description: ASL letter F - Index and thumb touching, other fingers up
F.instructions: Touch your index finger and thumb of your left hand, keep other fingers up

G.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
G.description: ASL letter G - Index finger pointing to the side
G.instructions: Point your index finger to the side with your left hand

H.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L80 150 M120 50 L120 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
H.description: ASL letter H - Index and middle fingers pointing to the side
H.instructions: Point your index and middle fingers to the side with your left hand

I.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50 M80 70 L120 70 M80 90 L120 90 M80 110 L120 110 M80 130 L120 130" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
I.description: ASL letter I - Pinky finger pointing up
I.instructions: Point your pinky finger up with your left hand, keeping other fingers closed

J.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50 M80 70 L120 70 M80 90 L120 90 M80 110 L120 110 M80 130 L120 130" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
J.description: ASL letter J - Pinky finger pointing up, then draw a J
J.instructions: Point your pinky finger up, then move your left hand in a J shape

K.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L80 150 M120 50 L120 150 M80 100 L120 100" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
K.description: ASL letter K - Index and middle fingers pointing up, thumb between them
K.instructions: Point your index and middle fingers up with your left hand, thumb between them

L.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L80 150 M80 50 L120 50" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
L.description: ASL letter L - Index finger and thumb forming L shape
L.instructions: Form an L shape with your index finger and thumb of your left hand

M.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L80 150 M100 50 L100 150 M120 50 L120 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
M.description: ASL letter M - Three fingers pointing down
M.instructions: Point your index, middle, and ring fingers down with your left hand

N.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L80 150 M100 50 L100 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
N.description: ASL letter N - Index and middle fingers pointing down
N.instructions: Point your index and middle fingers down with your left hand

O.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="30" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
O.description: ASL letter O - Fingers curled to form a circle
O.instructions: Curl all fingers of your left hand to form a circle

P.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L80 150 M80 50 L120 50 L120 100 L80 100" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
P.description: ASL letter P - Index finger pointing down, thumb out
P.instructions: Point your index finger down with your left hand, thumb pointing out

Q.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50 M80 70 L120 70 M80 90 L120 90 M80 110 L120 110 M80 130 L120 130" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
Q.description: ASL letter Q - Index finger pointing down, thumb pointing to the side
Q.instructions: Point your index finger down with your left hand, thumb pointing to the side

R.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L80 150 M120 50 L120 150 M80 50 L120 100 M80 100 L120 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
R.description: ASL letter R - Index and middle fingers crossed
R.instructions: Cross your index and middle fingers of your left hand

S.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L120 50 L120 150 L80 150 Z" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
S.description: ASL letter S - Fist with thumb over fingers
S.instructions: Make a fist with your left hand, thumb over your fingers

T.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L120 50 M100 50 L100 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
T.description: ASL letter T - Index finger pointing up, thumb out
T.instructions: Point your index finger up with your left hand, thumb pointing out

U.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L80 150 M120 50 L120 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
U.description: ASL letter U - Index and middle fingers pointing up
U.instructions: Point your index and middle fingers up with your left hand

V.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L100 150 M120 50 L100 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
V.description: ASL letter V - Index and middle fingers in V shape
V.instructions: Form a V shape with your index and middle fingers of your left hand

W.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M70 50 L90 150 M100 50 L100 150 M130 50 L110 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
W.description: ASL letter W - Three fingers pointing up
W.instructions: Point your index, middle, and ring fingers up with your left hand

X.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L120 150 M120 50 L80 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
X.description: ASL letter X - Index finger bent
X.instructions: Bend your index finger of your left hand

Y.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50 M80 70 L120 70 M80 90 L120 90 M80 110 L120 110 M80 130 L120 130" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
Y.description: ASL letter Y - Thumb and pinky pointing out
Y.instructions: Point your thumb and pinky out with your left hand

Z.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M80 50 L120 50 L80 150 L120 150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
Z.description: ASL letter Z - Index finger drawing a Z
Z.instructions: Use your index finger to draw a Z shape in the air with your left hand

0.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="40" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
0.instructions: Make a fist with your left hand

1.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><line x1="100" y1="50" x2="100" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/></svg>
1.instructions: Extend only your index finger on your left hand

2.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><line x1="80" y1="50" x2="80" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="120" y1="50" x2="120" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/></svg>
2.description: ASL number 2 - Index and middle fingers extended
2.instructions: Extend your index and middle fingers on your left hand

3.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><line x1="70" y1="50" x2="70" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="100" y1="50" x2="100" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="130" y1="50" x2="130" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/></svg>
3.description: ASL number 3 - Index, middle, and ring fingers extended
3.instructions: Extend your index, middle, and ring fingers on your left hand

4.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><line x1="60" y1="50" x2="60" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="85" y1="50" x2="85" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="110" y1="50" x2="110" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="135" y1="50" x2="135" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/></svg>
4.description: ASL number 4 - All fingers extended except thumb
4.instructions: Extend all fingers except your thumb on your left hand

5.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><line x1="50" y1="50" x2="50" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="75" y1="50" x2="75" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="100" y1="50" x2="100" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="125" y1="50" x2="125" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="150" y1="50" x2="150" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/></svg>
5.instructions: Extend all fingers on your left hand

6.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50 M80 70 L120 70 M80 90 L120 90 M80 110 L120 110 M80 130 L120 130" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
6.description: ASL number 6 - Thumb and pinky extended
6.instructions: Extend your thumb and pinky on your left hand

7.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50 M80 70 L120 70 M80 90 L120 90 M80 110 L120 110 M80 130 L120 130" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
7.description: ASL number 7 - Thumb, index, and middle fingers extended
7.instructions: Extend your thumb, index, and middle fingers on your left hand

8.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50 M80 70 L120 70 M80 90 L120 90 M80 110 L120 110 M80 130 L120 130" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
8.description: ASL number 8 - Thumb and index finger extended
8.instructions: Extend your thumb and index finger on your left hand

9.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200"><path d="M100 50 L100 150 M80 50 L120 50 M80 70 L120 70 M80 90 L120 90 M80 110 L120 110 M80 130 L120 130" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>
9.instructions: Bend your index finger on your left hand

metadata.notes: This file contains all ASL alphabet letters A-Z and numbers 0-9 for left-handed signing
